Same review as John Doe below, except I did my transplant with beard hair as donor 6 years ago. Dr. Viroj convinced me this was the most viable solution. It looked terrible then, and it looks terrible now. My inclination is that he didn’t have the foresight or knowledge that my curly Italian beard hair wouldn’t behave the same as his other clients.

2 weeks ago I finished my second hair transplant with Dr Viroj and his professional team. A little bit early to see results but other than some pain in the donor area that subsided after a few days, I couldn't be happier. There are a lot of cheap hair transplant clinics in Thailand but if you want the best go and see Dr Viroj and his team.

The final results are in after 1 year , the results were not really as expected. The Dr used transplanted beard hair on my head and now it’s grown, looks curly and different from the rest of my hair. The Dr did not put enough grafts in and now it looks patchy. Perhaps I may need another one to fix it.
Really great experience and price. Doctor spoke English and studied in America. Will recommend.
